judge_anchors: Uses the 2017-06-07 to 2017-06-14 event window, giving 8 inclusive days.
Extracts 10000 evacuees and a lower bound of 500 destroyed houses from the report.
Counts three smoke signals: week-later smoke, smoke over Knysna, and offshore smoke front.
Computes baseline impact_load_index 87.50, process_coupling_index 93.84, and compound_response_pressure 90.35.

event_context.localities: Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, and the Outeniqua Mountains

response_priorities.basis: 10000 evacuees, more than 500 houses destroyed, and baseline impact_load_index 87.50
Garden Route closure plus three smoke signals including week-later smoke, Knysna smoke pall, and offshore smoke front
three fuel types, patchy burn wording, and drought/strong-wind spread signal drive process_coupling_index 93.84

notes: Off-event weather, precipitation, dNBR, WorldPop, and OSM products are not used in this ground truth.
The process and scenario indices are computed from the event anchor and NASA Earth Observatory report text.

criteria.description: Extracts the 8-day event window, localities, mountainous/coastal setting, 10000 evacuees, 500-house lower bound, Garden Route closure, and Charter request.
criteria.name: Event context and report extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for mostly correct context with one or two missed anchors.

criteria.description: Counts all three smoke signals, all three fuel mosaic terms, drought/strong-wind signal, and patchy-pattern signal.
criteria.name: Smoke and fuel-process signals
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correctly recovered signal family.

criteria.description: Applies the stated formulas and obtains impact_load_index 87.50, process_coupling_index 93.84, and compound_response_pressure 90.35.
criteria.name: Baseline process formulas
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-4 points for correct formulas with one or more arithmetic or normalization errors.

criteria.description: Applies the 20% evacuation and house-loss increases plus 10-day smoke persistence, yielding scenario compound pressure 92.57 and delta 2.22.
criteria.name: Scenario recomputation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for scenario direction without full recomputation.

criteria.description: Ranks evacuation/house-loss support, coastal access/smoke management, and fuel mosaic/patchy burn mapping with bases tied to computed drivers.
criteria.name: Response priorities
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for priorities that are plausible but weakly tied to the indices.

criteria.description: Returns valid JSON with the requested top-level keys and does not use off-event weather, precipitation, dNBR, WorldPop, or OSM products as scored evidence.
criteria.name: Source discipline and JSON format
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for valid JSON with one unsupported physical-product claim.
